scope: engineering interface sensitivity, not AFD biological validation
input: independent seed 53119, 112 piecewise constant temperature histories; background 0 K relative; input = random normal SD 0.007 K with dwell 0.3-0.9s
interfaces: raw temperature divided by 0.05 K vs repository ThresholdAdaptation: initial threshold 0 K, read response before updating threshold each 0.1s; 45/840s adaptation from literature, response width 0.05 K and gain uncalibrated
target: clean temperature change over 0.5s scaled by 0.05 K; readout input only, RIA or all nodes
models: real and rewired 101/104, uniform chemical mask and random source signs 7/17/27; fixed gap, Heun 0.025s; ridge train/validation/test 64/16/32
limitations: first-record threshold artificial; no fitted AFD calcium, no biological sign or synaptic efficacy, no behavior, raw and rectified interfaces carry different information and are not causal proof
